an3.8:1.1: Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo. Katamehi tīhi? Savyāpajjhena kāyakammena . . . pe . . . savyāpajjhena manokammena . . . pe . . . Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo. Katamehi tīhi? Avyāpajjhena kāyakammena . . . pe . . . avyāpajjhena manokammena. Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo.
an3.8:2.1: Tasmāt iha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ. Yehi tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo te tayo dhamme abhinivajjetvā yehi tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo te tayo dhamme samādāya vattissāmā ti. Evaṃ hi vo sikkhitabban ti.
